name: Codex usage
description: Local signed-in CLI quota snapshot; account authentication stays on the collector host.
template:
<Stack data-gp="usage-codex" p={2} gap={2} style={{fontFamily:"inherit",width:"100%",boxSizing:"border-box",minWidth:0}}>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={3} wrap="nowrap"><Tooltip label={data.snapshot?.codex?.capturedAt ? "Updated " + data.snapshot?.codex.ageText : "Waiting for usage"}><Group gap={4} wrap="nowrap"><TablerIcon name="code" size={13}/><Text title={data.snapshot?.codex?.capturedAt ? "Updated " + data.snapshot?.codex.ageText : "Waiting for usage"} size="xs" fw={700} lh={1.1}>Codex usage</Text></Group></Tooltip><Group gap={3} wrap="nowrap">{data.snapshot?.codex?.stale ? <Badge size="xs" variant="light" color="yellow">Stale</Badge> : null}<RefreshButton requestId="snapshot" size="xs"/></Group></Group>
{status.snapshot?.ok === false ? <Text size="xs" c="red">Feed unavailable</Text> : !data.snapshot ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Loading…</Text> : (data.snapshot?.codex?.windows ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Waiting for limits</Text> : <Stack gap={3}>{(data.snapshot?.codex?.windows ?? []).map(w => <Tooltip key={w.label} label={w.usedPercent.toFixed(0) + "% used · resets " + w.resetAtUtc}><Stack gap={2}><Group justify="space-between" gap={3} wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" lh={1.1}>{w.label}</Text><Text title={w.usedPercent.toFixed(0) + "% used · resets " + w.resetAtUtc} size="xs" lh={1.1} c={w.usedPercent >= 90 ? "red" : w.usedPercent >= 75 ? "yellow" : "teal"}>{w.usedPercent.toFixed(0) + "% used · " + w.resetText}</Text></Group><Progress value={w.usedPercent} size={3} radius="xl" color={w.usedPercent >= 90 ? "red" : w.usedPercent >= 75 ? "yellow" : "teal"} aria-label={w.label + " percent used; time to reset"}/></Stack></Tooltip>)}</Stack>}
</Stack>
